graph.name: Clumio Backup as a Service AWS Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture showing how Clumio ingests encrypted customer backups directly into S3, processes metadata via EventBridge and SQS into a Metadata Engine, and performs post-processing on backups using cross-account IAM roles and Lambda.

nodes.name: CFT
nodes.notes: CloudFormation template installed on customer side to set up event triggers and IAM roles.

nodes.name: EBS / RDS / DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Customer data sources containing volumes, databases, and tables requiring backup.

nodes.name: EventBridge
nodes.notes: Captures configuration and environment state changes on the customer side.

nodes.name: KMS
nodes.notes: Provides key management for customer data encryption prior to transfer.

nodes.name: IAM Role
nodes.notes: Cross-account IAM role providing permissions for Clumio to perform post-processing.

nodes.name: S3 Data Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores encrypted backup objects transferred directly from customer account.

nodes.name: Lambda Post-processing
nodes.notes: Performs compression, data optimization, indexing, and data integrity checks on S3 objects.

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Buffers incoming metadata event messages from EventBridge.

nodes.name: Lambda Metadata
nodes.notes: Processes metadata messages from SQS to analyze backup health and metrics.

nodes.name: Metadata Engine
nodes.notes: Data engine storing analyzed metadata for creating customer reports and recommendations.

nodes.name: S3 Output Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores generated compliance, audit, and cost recommendation reports.

edges.notes: CFT provisions IAM roles in destination account during onboarding.
Customer data sources send encrypted backup data directly into Clumio S3 Data Bucket.
Lambda post-processing reads and operates on S3 backup objects.
Lambda assumes IAM role to operate across customer and Clumio accounts.
EventBridge sends environment change events to SQS queue.
Lambda Metadata consumes metadata messages from SQS queue.
Lambda Metadata writes analyzed metadata to Metadata Engine.
Lambda Metadata writes report and recommendation outputs to S3 Output Bucket.
